description: Attributes and listeners not declared as props or emits, applied to the root element by default.
Object holding the fallthrough attributes, including `class`, `style` and `on*` listeners. Always current but not reactive.
Option that disables automatic fallthrough so you can bind `$attrs` to a chosen element.
Vue 3.3+ macro to set component options such as `name` and `inheritAttrs` from `<script setup>`.
